item.description: When asked whether he would present the state budget this year and for the rest of the term, the Chief Minister replied, "Why are you (media) asking this question? Yes, I will continue as the Chief Minister and will also present the budget."

item.title: How AI-native digital construction platforms permanently rewrite economics of civil and electrical infra
item.description: The choice is now binary and irreversible: adopt a fully autonomous AI-native construction stack before 2027 and secure permanent membership of the $2 trillion value elite, or remain analog and be priced out of the market forever, writes Major General Dilawar Singh.

item.title: 'Deeply regret the loss of life': CDS Anil Chauhan on Tejas fighter crash at Dubai Air Show
item.description: The Indian Air Force Tejas fighter jet crashed during a demonstration at the Dubai Air Show on Friday, and the pilot lost his life.

item.title: Natasa gifts herself Rs 3.04 crore orange SUV, goes on solo drive amid ex-husband Hardik
item.description: Natasa Stankovic flaunted her swanky ₹3 crore orange Land Rover Defender as she was papped driving it around Mumbai. Natasa and Hardik parted ways in July 2024 after four years of marriage, but continue to co-parent their son, Agastya.

item.title: SBI Research: FY26 CAD May Ease to 1% of GDP on Firm Trade Performance
item.description: The report from SBI Research forecasts that the current account deficit (CAD) will be about 1.8 per cent and 2.8 per cent of GDP in Q2 and Q3 FY26, respectively, before it will turn into the positive territory in Q4 FY26.
